title: Exclusion of harm to product itself and certain losses
description: The provision excludes harm caused to a product itself and certain losses from the definition of harm in relation to product liability

content.general_rule: Harm in relation to product liability includes various types of damage or loss
content.exception: Does not include harm caused to a product itself or any damage to the property on account of breach of warranty conditions or any commercial or economic loss
conditions: direct, incidental or consequential loss relating thereto
